assessment.summary: This study analyzes whole-genome sequence data from 765 wild-caught Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii mosquitoes from eight African countries to investigate genetic variation in the Vgsc gene. It identifies 23 non-synonymous variants, including known resistance alleles (L995F, L995S, N1570Y) and novel mutations, and uses haplotype analysis to infer the geographical spread and selective history of these resistance markers.
